# Clinique Vétérinaire Maârif

> Veterinary clinic in the Maârif district of Casablanca, Morocco, caring for dogs, cats and NAC (exotic pets) since 2002. Surgery, imaging, laboratory, dentistry and 7/7 emergency line. Located at 60, Boulevard Bir Anzarane. Phone +212 5 22 23 30 95, emergencies +212 6 61 49 26 18, WhatsApp booking available.

Clinique Vétérinaire Maârif is a small-animal veterinary clinic led by Dr Adib Bassir, veterinary surgeon and clinic director. Rated 4.3/5 from 175 Google reviews. The clinic serves the Maârif, Gauthier and Anfa neighbourhoods of Casablanca. Content is available in Arabic, French, English and Russian.

- [Contact](https://vetclinic-website.okhowazaki.workers.dev/contact/): booking by WhatsApp or phone, map, hours.
- [Areas served](https://vetclinic-website.okhowazaki.workers.dev/zones/): Maârif, Gauthier, Anfa.
